dataset_info.notes: Voice-activity detection eval: positives are general speech recordings (the not-wake-word speech subset — speech that is not a wake word); negatives are non-speech audio pooled across public-domain sounds, environmental audio (ESC-50), music (FMA) and ambient noise. A fighter must fire 'speech' on the positives (low false-reject) and stay silent on the negatives (low false-accept).
